summary: All 4 reorder holes (eps 19-22) promoted to full exact records with own starts, page splits, and non-contiguous skips — no zone_level_only verdicts needed. Unlike the eps 14-18 interleave, the back half turns out to be a clean per-episode decomposition of the 121-164 zone: heavily abridged (whole-chapter skips 127, 140-142, 145, 147, 154, 161 — exactly batch 9's stored skip set, confirmed) but monotonic BETWEEN episodes: ep 19 = 121-132 (many page fragments), ep 20 = 133-144 (fragments at 135/138/139/143/144), ep 21 = 146-156 (147, 154 skipped), ep 22 = 157-164 (161 skipped). Fandom episode pages and animefillerguide agree chapter-for-chapter on all four; independent corroboration from Wikipedia episode summaries (event-level, every END's final scene matches the END chapter's fandom summary content exactly: Dragon emergence = 144, Mutsuki/Quinx tears = 156, Kaneki-Hide rooftop resolve = 164) and a MAL episode-7 discussion thread (manga readers pin ch 125 inside ep 19). Volume fields on fandom chapter infoboxes (132→v12, 144→v13, 156/164→v15) match the seeded boundary table. Ep 18's batch-15 continue point (121, 'ep 19 starts 121 p.7-11') is confirmed by ep 19's list.

HOLE resolved: opens on rampaging Dragon (146; 145 skipped everywhere), alliance + metal-detector search (148-153, 147 skipped), ends with Mutsuki vs Urie/Saiko resolving in tears ('part of our family') = ch 156 'Interior'... final scene content matches ch 156's fandom summary exactly (Saiko knocks the knife away, Mutsuki bursts into tears). 154 skipped everywhere.

Final scene = Kaneki-Hide rooftop reveal + resolve to fight = ch 164 'The White One' ending exactly per fandom ch-164 summary. continue_points.note: END=144 but 145 is adapted in no episode (permanent skip, per batch-9 cut list + both chapter tables); the anime's next material is 146 (ep 21 start). A strict no-gap reader resumes at 145.

flags_for_sean: Batch-9 zone annotation for eps 19-22 (abridged {121-164}, cuts 127, 140-142, 145, 147, 154, 161) is CONFIRMED exactly — no boundary or skip-set change needed; the zone is now fully decomposed into per-episode anchors, and unlike eps 14-18 there is no between-episode interleaving here (purely abridged, monotonic). The 'reorder hole' framing dissolves for this stretch: reordering is only intra-episode scene shuffling (fandom: 'some scenes are rearranged and merged, and some are added').

Ep 19's closing scene (Furuta and the Clowns prepping the 'final secret weapon') is not clearly attributable to any chapter in the fandom list — likely an anime-original/merged stinger setting up ep 20; recorded in the anchor note, no chapter number invented for it.
Ch 121 pages 1-6 are adapted in no episode (ep 19 uses only p.7-11, 18; eps 17-18 never reach 121) — a page-level micro-gap at the zone seam, consistent with batch 15's ep-18 continue point of 121.
